Hannah’s prayers are remarkably similar to Zechariah’s, and it makes me wonder;

“What kind of intimacy with God allows someone to finally receive the very thing they have desperately wanted, only to place it back into His hands?”
The best business ideas come from intimacy with God,  not the marketplace.

The Christian life was never meant to be lived secondhand.

You can borrow someone else’s insight but you can’t borrow someone else’s intimacy with God. Don’t settle for hearing about God when He’s inviting you to know Him yourself.
Isn’t He so intentional?🥹
Every time I truly repented it brought me into a higher level of intimacy with God. Few things have accelerated my spiritual growth more than this

There are levels of intimacy with God that are required for you to have to get through certain tests, trails and warfare. what got you through the last season won’t sustain you in this one, it’s time to go deeper.
“My intimacy with God isn’t measured by my answered prayers but by what God reveals to me that I never knew; His secrets and mysteries revealed”

I hate to break it to you, but prioritising time with God, studying the word, taking captive negative thoughts, killing sin and walking the narrow path will make your intimacy with God and every part of your life better than anything else.

Psalms 9:10✨️
Those who know Your name trust in You…” — not because life is always easy, but because God has never failed to keep His word🤍
Reminded that intimacy with God produces confidence, not fear.🤍

fullName: Jesus Is Our Shield Worldwide Ministries
text:
When you go deep in intimacy with God, you are the most peaceful person living on earth.

Not once will you be moved.

There is something more terrifying than losing your money, your health, or your reputation... It's losing your intimacy with God without even noticing. That is exactly what happened to Samson. What destroyed Samson wasn't Delilah. It wasn't the Philistines. It wasn't even the scissors that cut his hair. Those were only the final scenes of a battle he had been losing for years. Here's the mystery. How could a man chosen by God... Filled with supernatural strength... Anointed before birth...
You cannot claim intimacy with God while treating people unjustly because the image of the Divine lives in them. That is hypocrisy.

You read the Bible. You listen to sermons. But you don’t sit with God.

You consume Christian content.
You quote verses. You take notes.
But your soul still feels dry.

Because information is not intimacy.
And noise is not presence.

Here are 5 brutal truths about your distracted devotion:
(Save this)

A 7-Day Intimacy With God Reading Plan

1. Day 1: Psalm 27
2. Day 2: Psalm 63
3. Day 3: Exodus 33
4. Day 4: John 15
5. Day 5: Ephesians 3
6. Day 6: Philippians 3
7. Day 7: 1 John 4

A simple prayer before reading:

Father, I don’t just want to know about You. I want to know You. Draw me close, teach me to recognize Your voice, and help me delight in Your presence. In Jesus’ name, amen.
without private worship and intimacy with God, public worship is only a performance.

“When have I been absolutely wrong?” 🤔 Perhaps when I wake up fleeing intimacy with God like a child rushing outside to play. I abandon His plans for the day, neglect to check in, and fail to ask for His guidance and blessing. Instead, I pursue my own will and joy. 🙏🏾🕊️ Before running into the world, seek the One who already knows the way. ✝️

“Commit your works to the LORD, and your thoughts will be established.” — Proverbs 16:3 NKJV

You CANNOT be HOLY without intimacy with God the Father through Jesus Christ. 
-Dale Mast

Enoch was the only human recorded in history that God “took” for Himself. He did not die.

Enoch was a family man with sons and daughters.

That should show you that walking in holiness and intimacy with God is possible WHILE STILL BEING MARRIED WITH KIDS.

Selah.

There is no shortcut to intimacy with God.
There is no shortcut to building a relationship with Him.
A close relationship with God is cultivated through intentional time with Him. You must learn to come before the Lord for yourself to pray, seek Him, inquire, and grow in the knowledge of His Word. You can learn from ministers. You can honour spiritual authority. You can receive wisdom from others.
But no one can build your relationship with God for you.

Intimacy with GOD grow you in discernment 

#christian #philipanthonymitchell #church #discernment #followersofchrist

If it costs you your intimacy with God, it’s too expensive.

I prayed for an opportunity. It came through a man of God—but it drained my prayer life, fasting, and focus. I assumed it was right, but even spiritual recommendations aren’t a substitute for God’s voice.

Lesson: Guard your closeness with God more than any opportunity.

why do you start losing everything when you surrender to God?
When you surrender it all to God. It’s Crazy how personal growth can make you let go of people you swore you couldn't live without. ✌🏾
How did you learn to surrender to God’s plan?

How do you surrender your burdens to God?

We often hear, “Give it to God,” but what does that actually look like in everyday life? How do you let go of the weight you’re carrying while still trusting Him?

I surrender everything to You, Lord. Let Your will be done. 

Lord, I surrender everything to You. Help me trust Your timing, accept Your will, and find peace even while I wait.

Sometimes surrender is hard because we want to control everything.

We want to know what happens next, when it will happen, and why things are taking so long.

But maybe surrender is not losing. Maybe it is trusting God enough to let Him lead.

So if life feels uncertain right now, breathe.
Surrender your life's to God please.
